title: Grid placement and areas
summary: Make grid items span several columns and lay out a page with named grid areas.

quiz.q: What does `grid-column: span 2` do to a grid item?
options: Moves it 2 columns to the right
quiz.explain: `span 2` means the item occupies two column tracks, starting wherever the browser would place it.

quiz.q: In `grid-template-areas`, what does a repeated name in a row mean?
quiz.explain: `"header header"` makes the area called header span both columns of that row.

quiz.q: Assign the element to the area named `sidebar`.
quiz.explain: `grid-area: sidebar` places the element in the area with that name.

quiz.q: Put the rule that builds a header, sidebar and main layout in order.
quiz.explain: First turn the container into a grid, define the columns, then draw the layout row by row with `grid-template-areas`. Each string is a row.

exercise.task:
Place items in a four-column grid and a page layout. Work in `index.html`.

- `.feature` spans two columns using `grid-column: span 2`.
- `.page` is a grid with `grid-template-columns: 200px 1fr`, and `grid-template-areas` of `"header header"` over `"sidebar main"`.
- Assign `header`, `.sidebar` and `.main` to the areas named `header`, `sidebar` and `main` with `grid-area`.
hints: Spanning uses grid-column: span N on the item. Areas are named in the container and assigned with grid-area on each child.
Each string inside grid-template-areas is a row. Names must match the grid-area values exactly.

checks.name: .feature is wider than a normal cell
checks.hint: Check .grid has four columns and .feature spans two of them.

checks.name: .page defines areas named header, sidebar and main
checks.hint: Write grid-template-areas with the names header, sidebar and main in the rows.

checks.name: The header is placed in the header area
checks.hint: Add grid-area: header; to the header.

checks.name: .sidebar is placed in the sidebar area
.main is placed in the main area
The sidebar sits to the left of the main area
checks.hint: The first column should be 200px (180px of content plus 10px padding each side): grid-template-columns: 200px 1fr;.
